name: umami-mobile-automation
description: Cross-platform mobile automation framework for Android and iOS using WebdriverIO, Appium via USB, Cucumber, and Allure.

scripts.test:android:all: npm run test:android:auth:blank && npm run test:android:auth:invalid-email && npm run test:android:auth:incorrect-password && npm run test:android:forgot:nav && npm run test:android:forgot:unregistered && npm run test:android:signup:mandatory && npm run test:android:signup:mismatch && npm run test:android:signup:terms && npm run test:android:forgot:successful-reset && npm run test:android:signup:successful-registration && npm run test:android:auth:successful
scripts.test:ios:all: npm run test:ios:auth:blank && npm run test:ios:auth:invalid-email && npm run test:ios:auth:incorrect-password && npm run test:ios:forgot:nav && npm run test:ios:forgot:unregistered && npm run test:ios:signup:mandatory && npm run test:ios:signup:mismatch && npm run test:ios:signup:terms && npm run test:ios:forgot:successful-reset && npm run test:ios:signup:successful-registration && npm run test:ios:auth:successful
scripts.test:android:all:report: npm run report:clean && npm run test:android:all && npm run report:generate
scripts.report:clean: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('reports/allure-results', { recursive: true, force: true }); require('fs').rmSync('reports/allure-report', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test:android:report: npm run test:android:all && npm run report:generate
scripts.test:android:report:open: npm run test:android:all && npm run report:generate && npm run report:open
scripts.test:ios:report: npm run test:ios:all && npm run report:generate
scripts.test:ios:report:open: npm run test:ios:all && npm run report:generate && npm run report:open
scripts.test:all:report: npm run test:android:all && npm run test:ios:all && npm run report:generate
scripts.test:all:report:open: npm run test:android:all && npm run test:ios:all && npm run report:generate && npm run report:open
